title: Senior Connectivity & Network Engineer
description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
  
  
**Job Description**
This role involves the development and application of engineering practice and knowledge in the following technologies: Standards and protocols, application software and embedded software for wireless and satellite networks, fixed networks and enterprise networks; connected devices (IOT and device engineering), connected applications (5G/ edge, B2X apps); and Telco Cloud, Automation and Edge Compute platforms. This role also involves the integration of network systems and their operations, related to the above technologies.
  
  
**Job Description - Grade Specific**
Focus on Connectivity and Network Engineering. Fully competent in own area. Acts as a key contributor in a more complexor critical environment. Proactively acts to understand and anticipates client needs. Manages costs and profitability for a work area. Manages own agenda to meet agreed targets. Develop plans for projects in own area. Looks beyond the immediate problem to the wider implications. Acts as a facilitator, coach and moves teams forward.
  
  
Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

title: System Administrator II
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
  
  
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.
  
  
This role is responsible for implementation, support and troubleshooting of server systems including operating systems, software, compute server, storage, virtualization, email, Active Directory and cloud. The role includes providing input into new and existing server configuration. This role will conduct analysis of specification requirements, as well as development and implementation of standards and procedures. Will also conduct system audit reviews and perform maintenance functions as required to ensure system health.
  
  
**Work Requirements**
This is a hybrid model role, requiring employees to work from the office 2 days per week.
  
  
Work Location - New Delhi
  
  
The position follows a five-day workweek, Monday through Friday. Flexible Working Hours.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Implement, upgrade, maintain and troubleshoot server systems including operating systems, software, compute server, storage, virtualization, email, Active Directory, and cloud.
* Monitor and troubleshoot server performance (availability, capacity, and utilization).
* Procure server equipment and manage subcontractors involved with server installations.
* Provide server technical support directly to users and through ticketing systems.
* Create technical support documentation for server systems and processes.
* Coordinate additional resources needed to accomplish tasks and projects.
* Develop, implement and maintain policies and procedures.
* Escalate service requests as needed to meet client expectations.
* Participate in supporting server projects and initiatives.
* Provide on-call and remote troubleshooting support as needed.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in information systems, Computer Science or equivalent experience
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with computer servers, storage, VMware, Exchange, Active Directory, Antivirus, Group Policy and Backup software.
* Professional IT Certifications in Microsoft, VMware, and AWS preferred

**Required Skills**

* Ability to implement, administer and troubleshoot server infrastructure (operating systems, software, compute server, storage, virtualization and cloud)
* Ability to manage small projects, work in a team or independently under minimal supervision
* In-depth knowledge of server infrastructure (operating systems, software, compute server, storage, virtualization, and cloud).
* In-depth knowledge of Active Directory, GPO, DNS, and DHCP.
* In-depth knowledge of Disaster Recovery / Business Continuity Planning and testing.
* Ability to work in a team or independently under minimal supervision.
* Good problem solving, communications, time management and organizational skills.
* Knowledge of Symantec, Veeam, NetBackup, Citrix, AWS, Nutanix, Azure preferred.
* Knowledge SharePoint, sFTP, Windows printer server routers, Solarwinds, Wireshark, preferred.
* Ability to multi-task, prioritize and manage time efficiently.
* Ability to provide off hour support for implementations, upgrades, testing and troubleshooting.
* Excellent critical thinking, problem solving and analytical skills with attention to detail.

title: Sr. Staff Platform Operations Engineer (with OpenStack)
description:
**Business Area:**
**Seniority Level:**
Mid-Senior level
  
  
**Job Description:**
At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.
  
  
The Cloudera IT team is looking for a talented, motivated, and passionate Sr. Staff Platform Operations Engineer to join our Technical Operations organization. In this role, you will help design and run the internal platform that our engineers and business teams rely on every day, owning the deployment, reliability, and automated management of our Linux-based infrastructure and core IT services across on‑premise and cloud. As a technical leader and subject matter expert, you’ll combine deep Linux systems experience with infrastructure-as-code, automation, and security-first thinking to build a highly available, compliant, and scalable foundation for the company.
  
  
**As a Sr. Staff Platform Operations Engineer you will:**

* Architect, deploy, and provide senior-level operational support for our on-premise and cloud-based Linux infrastructure and core IT services (e.g., virtualization, baremetal, storage, DNS), ensuring high availability and reliability.
* Develop, maintain, and champion our Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and automation frameworks using tools like Terraform, Ansible, and Foreman/MaaS to manage and deploy platform services.
* Implement and automate system-level security best practices, including patching, hardening, and configuration management, ensuring compliance and resilience from the ground up.
* Build and automate deployment pipelines for IT infrastructure services (e.g., system images, configuration, platform services) using tools like GitHub/Git, Ansible, and scripting tools.
* Serve as a technical Subject Matter Expert (SME), working with IT Systems, CloudOps, Security, and Engineering teams to design and implement robust, scalable, and optimal solutions.
* Participate in a shared on-call rotation to support mission-critical IT services (with clear documentation and runbooks provided).
* Create and maintain accurate documentation for automation, operational audits, and compliance.
* Design, implement, and administer enterprise storage platforms, including Dell PowerStore and Pure Storage arrays, ensuring capacity, performance, data protection, and high availability for critical workloads.
* Mentor junior team members.

**We are excited if you have (Required Qualifications):**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or 8+ years of equivalent experience in a large-scale enterprise environment.
* Solid experience managing hybrid infrastructure, with deep expertise in on-premise environments (virtualization, OpenStack, networking) and a strong understanding of core public cloud services (AWS/Azure/GCP) and containerized platforms (Kubernetes).
* Deep, expert-level Linux systems administration experience (e.g., Red Hat, Rocky, Ubuntu) and mastery of common Command Line Interface (CLI) tools and services.
* Strong hands-on skills with Python and shell scripting, used for systems automation, tooling, and integration.
* Proven experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) and version control (GitHub/Git).
* Hands-on experience administering enterprise storage arrays, ideally including Dell PowerStore and Pure Storage FlashArray (provisioning, performance tuning, upgrades, and troubleshooting).
* A security-first mindset and experience designing, building, and operating secure, automated infrastructure.
* Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls), including public cloud equivalents.

**You may also have:**

* Certifications such as Red Hat (RHCE), Terraform, or public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Knowledge of enterprise security principles, cryptography, PKI, and operational security practices.
* Experience operating in regulated/high-governance/compliance environments (e.g., FedRAMP, PCI, ISO27001, SOC2, etc.).
* Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools.
* Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes).
* Project management experience.
* Previous experience mentoring junior team members.

**This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.**
**What you can expect from us:**

* Generous PTO Policy
* Support work life balance with Unplugged Days
* Flexible WFH Policy
* Mental & Physical Wellness programs
* Phone and Internet Reimbursement program
* Access to Continued Career Development
* Comprehensive Benefits and Competitive Packages
* Paid Volunteer Time
* Employee Resource Groups

title: Customer Experience Splunk Technical Leader
description:
**Meet the Team**
As a Customer Success Technical Leader, you are passionate about customers and will fuel solutions to ensure every customer request makes the deepest impact possible for our customers and share the best-of-the-best with the team. You will be a Splunk expert and adept at understanding, adapting, and guiding our account teams and customers on how to best use our Platform.
  
  
**Your impact**
**Responsibilities**

* Skilled and aligned to Splunk Security license products, such as Enterprise Security (ES), security applications like Splunk User Behavior Analytics (UBA), and/or SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response)
* Highly skilled and aligned to Splunk’s Core licensed product, such as Enterprise and Cloud.
* Strategically support the Customer Success Executive, Technical Success Engineer, Solution Engineer, Solution Architect motions.
* Develop strong partnership with Sales/Customer Success roles to assist Area aligned customers with Value Realization. Activities include, but not limited to:

+ Onboarding & Enablement – deliver workshops, prescriptive guidance/assistance, achieve onboarding milestones
+ Health Review & Remediation
+ Security Use Case Activation
+ Proactively engaging Technical Success Engineers to review and assess their account’s health situation, with an emphasis on accounts that have telemetry risk signals and/or 6 months from renewal date.
+ Proactively engaging Customer Success Executives on adoption/use case-related work opportunity.
+ Proactively engage CS/SE Management to ensure priority focus alignment and address risk accounts themes.
+ Strategic case-based delivery, up to 90 days of assistance, which is requested by internal Area aligned account teams or management. This typically involves providing customers with high-quality technical advice on Enterprise level architecture, implementation, configuration and optimization work in complex environments for Splunk Enterprise Security, UBA/UEBA, and/or SOAR.

**As a Customer Success Technical Leader, you will**

* Be passionate about customers and deliver impactful solutions.
* Address organizations’ complex technical challenges, proactively identifying and resolving issues before they impact the customer.
* Be a self-motivated Splunk expert eager to learn and adapt in a multifaceted environment.
* Guide account team members and customers on optimal use of Splunk Platform and Splunk Enterprise Security. Provide recommendations for a customer’s overall technical health.
* Deliver strategic, case-based technical consulting (up to 90 days).
* Collaborate with internal resources and customer-facing teams to manage customer needs.
* Conduct research from various resources with the ability to consistently find answers to questions and solve complex technical problems.
* Execute consultative conversations with decision makers to diagnose and establish the potential value of solving business issues, change or expand existing solution requirements based on your discovery/assessment, and provide broader based recommendations to help customers accelerate their product initiatives, optimize cost, and maximize performance.
* Gain agreement with account team members and customer decision-makers on the tangible value of proposed solutions.
* Deliver customer onboarding enablement-based workshops and achieve success milestones.
* Contribute to practice KPIs through process and collateral improvements, tool development, and implementation.

**Minimum Qualifications-**

* Deep technical knowledge of Splunk Enterprise Security (ES) configuration, administration, and development, including expertise in Assets and Identities, Threat Intelligence, Notable Events, Adaptive Response, and Risk-based Analytics.
* Data Management: Experience with integrating and normalising data from diverse sources. Understanding of the Common Information Model (CIM) and experience with data onboarding, including forwarding architecture and technical add-ons.
* Strong command of Search Processing Language (SPL); experience developing and optimizing correlation and risk-based alerting rules.
* Strong Splunk architecture, data onboarding, and Splunk Core product feature experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cybersecurity Domain: Solid foundation in security operations, forensics, threat hunting, insider threats, and compliance.
* Cybersecurity Frameworks: Solid foundation in NIST CSF, CIS, HIPAA, PCI DSS
* Industry Standard Security Certifications: GIAC, CISSP, OSCP or equivalent
* Infrastructure: Understanding of enterprise architecture across on-premise and Cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Splunk Certifications/Accreditations: ES Implementation Accreditation and/or SOAR consultant I & II
* Understanding of enterprise architecture across on-premise and Cloud environments
* Statistical and analytical modeling skills are a plus.
* Proficiency with scripting languages (bash), application development (Java, Python, .NET), databases, and analytical tools.
* Hands-on experience with Splunk product implementation of focus and Splunk Cloud.
* Experience with cloud migration projects.
* Solid experience in technical consulting or big-data analytics.

**Soft Skills-**

* Trusted technical advisor with the ability to lead assigned tickets and priorities. Engages in “out of the box” thinking to resolve problems
* Relationship Management - Establish technical credibility with a wide range of internal and customer contacts with the ability to “read” the internal/customer contact and adapt behavior / approach
* Conflict Resolution - Ability to engage in escalation management
* Influencing/Negotiating - Ability to influence peers, Splunk leadership and customers. Ability to handle highly complex/distributed IT environments and/or accounts that demand a high level of negotiation and conflict resolution abilities
* Problem/Need Identification - Demonstrates a deep comprehension of the customers, account team and/or customer’s business strategy, business objectives & challenges, success criteria/how customer measures success, and training needs. Analyzes trends to predict changes that may impact customer’s long-term business goals
* Mentor/Team Player - Possesses ability to take on mentorship roles as identified by management team. Identifies, defines, and leads Priorities to Improve to help team reach its goals
* Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills. Active listening and objective consideration of others’ opinions.
* Strong customer-facing skills to instill confidence and guide towards resolution.

We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. title: Sr Network Architect (network + cloud+ security)
description:
**About Gartner IT:**
Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.
  
  
**About this role:**
Senior Network Architect is a senior technical leader responsible for the strategic vision, lifecycle planning, and architectural design of highly reliable, secure, and scalable multi-cloud and enterprise network infrastructure to support Gartner Conference and global business operations. The ideal candidate brings expert-level mastery in enterprise network design, zero-trust security frameworks, edge connectivity, and hybrid cloud ecosystems. They are passionate about setting architectural guardrails, authoring long-term technology roadmaps, and leveraging modern software-defined networking (SDN) and automation frameworks to drive transformative business outcomes.
  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* Define Strategy: Architect the global enterprise network blueprint spanning LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, multi-cloud ecosystems, and high-density event environments.
* Lead Security Architecture: Design enterprise-wide network security frameworks, integrating next-generation firewalls, SASE, zero-trust models, and micro-segmentation.
* Author Roadmaps: Establish long-term technology roadmaps, standard reference designs, and architectural guardrails Campus office, Data Center, and cloud connectivity.
* Drive Innovation: Evaluate and select emerging technologies, leading proof-of-concepts for SDN, intent-based networking, network automation, and AI frameworks.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with infrastructure team, application team, Infosec team, DevOps Team, Cloud CCOE team and End user team.
* Govern Documentation: Own the lifecycle of core reference architectures, global topology diagrams, infrastructure-as-code libraries, and standard compliance guidelines.
* Act as Highest Escalation: Serve as the ultimate technical authority for systemic, complex infrastructure or application performance anomalies.
* Mentor Teams: Provide technical governance and mentorship to senior network engineering teams, cultivating engineering excellence across the organization.

**What you’ll need:**

* Professional Experience: 12-17 years of deep technical experience in large-scale enterprise routing, switching, and complex network infrastructure design..
* Technical Governance: Ability to author and maintain global network architectural standards, high-level designs (HLD), low-level designs (LLD), and deployment blueprints.
* Core Routing & Switching: Master-level understanding of advanced routing protocols (BGP, OSPF) alongside high-density data center fabrics (spine-leaf) and modern campus network topologies.
* Enterprise Wireless: Deep technical knowledge of enterprise wireless LAN (WLAN) controllers, cloud-managed Wi-Fi architecture, RF engineering, and centralized wireless management platforms.
* Application Delivery & Load Balancing: Advanced, hands-on knowledge of F5 BIG-IP systems (LTM, DNS, APM), including deep familiarity with SSL/TLS termination, HTTP/HTTPS profiles, and iRules.
* Palo Alto Security Design: Strong experience in Palo Alto Networks infrastructure, designing secure deployments utilizing Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) managed via Strata Cloud Manager, user-ID/app-ID policies, and cloud-delivered security services.
* SASE & Edge Architecture: Expertise to architect and scale Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) and SD-WAN frameworks to provide optimized, secure connectivity for remote users and branch offices.
* Multi-Cloud Networking: Deep knowledge of cloud-native networking constructs, designing and securing high-performance transit networks across AWS (Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, VPCs) and Microsoft Azure (Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute, vNets).

**Who You Are**

* Graduate/Postgraduate in BE/B tech, ME/MTech or MCA are preferred.
* Excellent communication and prioritization skills.
* Able to work independently or within a team proactively in a fast-paced AGILE-SCRUM environment.
* Owns success – Takes responsibility for successful delivery of the solutions.
* Ardent desire to improve upon their skills in software development, frameworks, and technologies.

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.
  
  
**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
  
  
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Information Technology Administrator
description:
**IT Administrator, Idiotic Media**

**Location:**
Gurugram, Haryana (Work from Office)

**Experience:**
2-3 years

**Department:**
IT / Operations

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About the Role**

Idiotic Media is looking for an IT Administrator to keep our systems, network, and devices running smoothly. You'll be the go-to person for all things IT in a fast-moving media and content environment, supporting creative, editorial, and business teams so they can work without tech interruptions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide first- and second-level support to employees for hardware, software, network, and account issues, in person and remotely
* Set up, configure, and maintain laptops, desktops, printers, and peripherals, including onboarding and offboarding of devices
* Manage user accounts, email, and access permissions on Google Workspace / Microsoft 365
* Administer and monitor office network infrastructure (LAN/Wi-Fi, routers, switches, firewalls) and coordinate with ISPs
* Maintain an up-to-date IT asset inventory, licenses, and warranty/AMC records
* Handle software installation, patching, OS updates, and antivirus/endpoint security
* Support the creative team's needs, such as Mac/Windows workstations, Adobe Creative Cloud, shared storage, and NAS
* Run regular data backups and ensure basic disaster recovery readiness
* Enforce IT security policies, including password management, MFA, and access controls
* Manage vendor relationships and raise procurement requests for IT equipment
* Document processes, troubleshooting steps, and maintain a ticketing/helpdesk system
* Support video conferencing, meeting room setups, and event or shoot-related tech needs when required

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in IT, Computer Science, or a related field
* 2-3 years of experience as an IT Administrator, System Administrator, or IT Support Engineer
* Hands-on experience with Windows and macOS environments
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewalls)
* Experience administering Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365
* Familiarity with ticketing tools
* Strong troubleshooting skills and a service-oriented mindset
* Good written and verbal communication in English and Hindi

**Good to Have**

* Certifications such as CompTIA A+/Network+, CCNA, or MCSA
* Experience with MDM tools and endpoint management
* Basic knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Prior experience in a media, content, or creative agency setting
* Exposure to NAS/storage management and backup tools

**Key Skills**

Hardware & software troubleshooting · Network administration · User and access management · Asset management · IT security basics · Vendor coordination · Documentation

What We Offer

* A dynamic, creative work environment
* Opportunity to own and shape the IT setup as the company grows
* Competitive salary based on experience
* Learning and growth opportunities

How to Apply

Send your resume to
**rosita.thapa@idiotic.media**
with the subject line "IT Administrator, Gurugram".

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**About Gravitee**

Since 2015, Gravitee has grown into a global force, recognized as a 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for API Management. What started with four developers challenging the complexities of APIs has evolved into a revolutionary platform powering API and event stream ecosystems worldwide. We drive digital transformation for top enterprises - from Michelin to Roche to Blue Yonder - offering unmatched control over APIs and event streams.

Now, we are leading the next evolution: AI Agent Management. Our platform brings security and governance to the agentic ecosystem - with our Agent Gateway for A2A protocol communications, native Model Context Protocol (MCP) support, and multi-agent, multi-LLM control. We are building the infrastructure that lets enterprises unlock the full potential of AI, securely and at scale.

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will be part of a Platform Team dedicated to making Gravitee's products best in class in terms of both product and infrastructure. You will be responsible for building and maintaining the cloud infrastructure that powers Gravitee's platform, while also supporting our customers with exceptional technical expertise.

This is a hands-on, critical role in our organization. The right candidate will enjoy problem solving in a highly specialized and technical way - from delivering production-ready Kubernetes-based environments to investigating complex customer issues.

As Gravitee expands into AI Agent Management, the Platform team plays a critical role in ensuring our infrastructure can support AI workloads, agent orchestration, and the demanding performance requirements of real-time AI gateway operations.

AI at Gravitee is not about shortcuts - it is about working smarter, faster, and more sustainably at scale.

**Essential Skills**

The right candidate will possess at least the following skills:

* 5+ years of professional experience in infrastructure management
* Fluency with creating and managing Kubernetes clusters and Helm-based deployments
* Strong understanding of infrastructure and deployment automation
* Experience with Terraform, Docker, and certificate management (ZeroSSL, Let's Encrypt)
* Experience with continuous delivery tools (Argo Workflows, ArgoCD, Helm Charts)
* Cloud platform experience (Azure, AWS, GCP)
* Observability tooling (Grafana, Prometheus)
* Curiosity and commitment to continuous learning
* Patient, resilient problem-solver with great attention to detail

**Desired Skills**

Additionally, these skills are not required but preferable:

* Experience with API Management or Identity and Access Management platforms
* Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure requirements and GPU workload orchestration
* Experience supporting AI Gateway or LLM-serving infrastructure
* Knowledge of networking, service mesh, and traffic management patterns

**Core Values**

At Gravitee, We Believe Strongly In Living Our Core Values As a Team And As a Company. We Do Not Just Write Them - We Live Them

title: SOC Threat Hunter – Network Security
description:
Innspark is a deep-tech, product-based company specializing in cybersecurity products, AI, cloud solutions, and specialised hardware offerings such as drones, VTS, and telemedicine systems.

We are looking for a Threat Hunter with strong hands-on expertise in network traffic analysis, network security, threat detection, and proactive investigation of sophisticated cyber threats.

Role: Threat Hunter

Location: Delhi NCR

Experience: 2–6+ Years

Employment Type: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from Office

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Perform proactive threat hunting across network, endpoint, and security environments.

• Analyse network traffic, packet captures, network flows, DNS traffic, HTTP/HTTPS traffic, and other network telemetry to identify suspicious activity.

• Investigate anomalous network behaviour, Indicators of Compromise (IOCs), Indicators of Attack (IOAs), and potential command-and-control (C2) communication.

• Identify network-based attack techniques including lateral movement, reconnaissance, exploitation, persistence, data exfiltration, and C2 activity.

• Work with firewalls, IDS/IPS, NDR, SIEM, EDR/XDR, and other network and security monitoring technologies.

• Correlate network traffic with endpoint and security logs to identify attack patterns and establish the scope of an incident.

• Perform threat hunting based on adversary Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs), with strong understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

• Develop and improve network-based detection rules, hunting queries, and detection use cases.

• Analyse malware-related network behaviour and identify associated infrastructure, domains, IPs, and communication patterns.

• Investigate emerging threats, APT activity, malicious infrastructure, and sophisticated attack campaigns.

• Collaborate with SOC, Threat Intelligence, Incident Response, VAPT, and Detection Engineering teams.

• Document investigation findings, attack patterns, TTPs, and recommended detection/mitigation measures.

**Key Skills:**

• Threat Hunting

• Network Security

• Network Traffic Analysis

• Packet Analysis / PCAP Analysis

• Network Forensics

• IDS/IPS & NDR

• Firewall & Network Security Technologies

• DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, TCP/UDP

• SIEM / EDR / XDR

• IOC / IOA Analysis

• Threat Intelligence

• MITRE ATT&CK

• APT & Malware Analysis

• C2 Detection & Analysis

• Lateral Movement Detection

• Data Exfiltration Detection

• YARA / Sigma

• KQL / SPL or similar query languages

• Linux & Windows Security

• Scripting / Automation

**What We’re Looking For:**

• 2–6+ years of relevant experience in Threat Hunting, Network Security, SOC, Threat Detection, Incident Response, Network Forensics, or Threat Intelligence.

• Strong hands-on understanding of network protocols and network security concepts.

• Strong ability to analyse network traffic and identify suspicious patterns and attacker behaviour.

• Practical experience with packet capture and network analysis tools such as Wireshark, tcpdump, Zeek, Suricata, or similar technologies will be valuable.

• Ability to investigate an incident from network-level indicators and correlate findings across multiple security data sources.

• Strong analytical and investigative mindset with an interest in understanding how attackers operate.

This role is particularly suited for candidates who have strong hands-on experience in network security and network traffic analysis and want to work on proactive threat hunting and advanced cyber threat investigations.

Interested candidates can share their updated CV with us.

Email: recruitment@innspark.in

Visit: https://innspark.in/

description: * Network Automation & Orchestration: Develop low-level automation using Ansible, Terraform, Python, and Puppet to configure routers, switches, firewalls (Cisco, Arista, Palo Alto), and enforce policy-driven changes across hybrid environments. 2) Core Network Engineering: Hands-on expertise in Layer 2/3 protocols (MPLS, BGP, OSPF, VRRP, STP, VLANs) and physical/logical infrastructure design for large-scale, multi-region enterprise networks. 3) Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Implement version-controlled, repeatable network provisioning using Terraform modules, YAML-based configs, and Git workflows to manage complete network lifecycles. 4) Cloud Network Provisioning: Automate and manage cloud-native networking (VPCs, subnets, route tables, VPNs, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, firewalls, NACLs, Security Groups) in AWS, Azure, and GCP. 5) CI/CD for Network Ops: Integrate network changes into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI) for test-driven deployments with linting, validation, rollback, and minimal operational downtime. 6) Internet & Perimeter Security: Configure and manage internet-edge security layers (firewall policies, DDoS protection, IPS/IDS, web proxies) and ensure secure ingress/egress traffic flows. 7) Monitoring, Telemetry & Auto-Remediation: Deploy NMS/telemetry tools (SolarWinds, Prometheus, InfluxDB) and write custom scripts for real-time alerting, anomaly detection, and event-driven remediation. 8) Troubleshooting & Packet Analysis: Perform low-level debugging using packet captures (Wireshark/tcpdump), flow telemetry, syslog, and routing table state analysis to resolve incidents in multi-vendor networks. 9) Cross-Functional Collaboration & Documentation: Collaborate with CloudOps, DevOps, Security, and platform teams to align network architecture with application needs. Maintain up-to-date HLD/LLD, runbooks, topology maps, and compliance records. 10) Innovation & Optimization: Evaluate SDN, SASE, Zero Trust, and AI-based networking solutions to continuously improve agility, reliability, and performance of the network ecosystem.

title: Head of IT Infrastructure & Hub Services – Asia
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
You will be the senior regional face of Infrastructure & Hub Services across Asia, connecting business priorities with secure, scalable global infrastructure products and strong local execution. You will work with Business Areas, Business Technology Teams, countries, factories, sites and global product owners to turn infrastructure demand into clear decisions, coordinated delivery, adoption and measurable value. Your day may move from an executive discussion on regional priorities, to resolving a service-impact issue, shaping a business case, aligning a site rollout or challenging a local technology exception. You will protect business proximity while building one accountable, globally connected infrastructure organization that delivers locally.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Lead the regional Partnering & Support operating model, bringing Hub and Business Area teams together around clear service standards, support quality, demand, compliance and stakeholder outcomes
* Build trusted relationships with senior business, IT, country, site, factory and Real Estate leaders, translating operational priorities and pain points into a focused regional infrastructure agenda and applicable local applications
* Own one transparent view of regional infrastructure demand, dependencies, capacity, funding and value as well as shape and challenge demand, agree priorities and route work to the right global product or service owner
* Orchestrate infrastructure solutions end to end, from ideation and business case through architecture, delivery, transition, adoption and benefits tracking
* Connect regional needs to global infrastructure roadmaps across workplace, network, data center, cloud, operations, orchestration, user equipment and support
* Protect service outcomes and regional execution by coordinating site readiness, deployment, change adoption, onsite support, TechBars, Service Desk engagement and major-incident communication
* Drive a global-first and reuse-first approach as well as simplify local infrastructure, suppliers, tools and technical variants, and prevent unjustified duplication or unmanaged shadow IT
* Ensuring regional decisions comply with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data, risk, export-control, regulatory and IT/OT standards, escalate or stop delivery that breaches agreed guardrails as well as apply approved AI, data and automation capabilities where they improve infrastructure operations, workplace experience, observability, support or site delivery
* Build a high-performing, distributed regional team with strong business acumen, infrastructure breadth, solution-orchestration capability, product thinking and governance discipline as well as maintain active user-support communities that connect Infrastructure & Hub Services, Business Areas, onsite support teams and service desk agents to share information and resolve issues
* Manage regional value, forecasts, capacity, vendors and partners with transparent commercial discipline and measurable outcomes

**What You Bring**

* Proven senior leadership experience with accountability for complex regional or global infrastructure outcomes, teams, services and portfolios in a large enterprise
* Credibility with senior business and IT stakeholders, with the judgement to translate operating priorities, value drivers and pain points into practical infrastructure outcomes
* Broad knowledge of cloud, data center and edge, network, workplace, operations, cybersecurity, service management and IT/OT considerations
* Experience shaping infrastructure demand, developing business cases and mobilizing solution architects and multidisciplinary teams from idea through adoption
* Experience working through global product and service owners, managing roadmaps and backlogs and balancing enterprise reuse with legitimate regional needs
* A track record of enforcing standards, managing risk and exceptions, simplifying technology landscapes and challenging duplicated or non-standard solutions
* Practical understanding of how approved AI, data and automation capabilities can improve infrastructure operations and services
* Strong people and change leadership across diverse, distributed and multicultural teams, including leadership through influence across organizational boundaries
* Commercial and portfolio discipline across investment prioritization, budgeting, capacity, vendors, contracts and benefits realization
* Excellent executive and technical communication skills in English, relevant regional language capability is advantageous, together with willingness to engage regularly across countries and sites
* A degree in computer science, engineering, business technology or a related discipline or equivalent practical experience, relevant certifications are welcome

**About The Team**
Infrastructure & Hub Services is part of Siemens Energy's Digital Core. The team connects regional business needs with globally owned infrastructure products and services, while enabling strong local execution. We work across organizational boundaries to improve infrastructure adoption, service quality, operational stability, user experience, governance and measurable business value.
  
  
This role operates as an integrator, not a parallel local technology organization. Business Areas and Business Technology Teams retain accountability for business priorities, applications, process transformation and funding, while global owners retain accountability for their product architecture, roadmaps, operations, security and lifecycle.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

title: Cyber Security Enterprise Architect
description:
How to contribute to our vision
  
  
This role is a replacement for business continuity, filling a critical position as a Cyber Security Enterprise Architect within the central Enterprise Architecture team. As an Expert Professional, the position is responsible for defining, co-developing, and leading the implementation of the cybersecurity strategy and architecture for Siemens Energy on a global scale. To fulfill this strategic objective, the role is structured around three core pillars: cyber security strategy and architecture governance, secure digital transformation (incl. cloud security, OT/IT convergence, and AI security) and Technical Leadership & Solution Oversight, which entails providing expert guidance on security implementation and acting as a top-tier authority on complex security matters. Given the focus on strategic design and expert-level guidance, the ideal candidate will be a recognized master in cybersecurity architecture. This requires extensive experience in experience designing security architectures across both Enterprise IT and Operational Technology (OT) environments in critical infrastructure, utilities, manufacturing, or energy sectors. It also requires deep knowledge of cloud security (AWS/Azure), and proven expertise in areas like risk management, SIEM, and Identity and Access Management. Advanced professional certifications are expected.
  
  
What You Need To Make a Difference
  
  

* 40% Enterprise Security Strategy & Architecture

+ Analyze emerging cyber security trends, threats, regulatory requirements, and technology advancements to continuously evolve the enterprise security architecture and strengthen the organization's cyber resilience.
+ Define and communicate the target Cyber Security Architecture vision across the enterprise, ensuring alignment with business strategy, digital transformation initiatives, regulatory obligations, and risk appetite
+ Develop and maintain the Cyber Security Architecture roadmap, assessing current-state capabilities and defining target-state architectures, transition plans, and investment priorities.
+ stablish enterprise-wide security architecture principles, standards, guardrails, reference architectures, and design patterns covering applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, AI solutions, Operational Technology (OT), and IoT environments.
+ rive the integration of cyber security requirements into enterprise architecture governance, technology portfolio management, and investment decision processes.

* 30% Secure Digital Transformation

+ Drive security-by-design and privacy-by-design across all business and technology initiatives, ensuring cyber security requirements are integrated into solution delivery from inception to deployment.
+ Lead architecture assessments and evaluate alternative technology solutions, balancing business value, security risk, operational resilience, scalability, compliance, and cost.
+ Partner with Enterprise Architects, Solution Architects, Security Operations, Infrastructure, Application Development, Data, AI, and OT teams to ensure consistent implementation of security architecture standards.
+ Define the security architecture framework for cloud, hybrid-cloud, and edge computing environments, including identity, network security, workload protection, encryption, and monitoring capabilities.
+ Shape the strategic direction for Identity and Access Management (IAM), Zero Trust Architecture, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Cyber Defense, and Security Monitoring capabilities.

* 30% Technical Leadership & Solution Oversight

+ Serve as the senior technical authority and escalation point for complex security incidents, investigations, and architectural challenges.
+ Support Executive Management and Digital Transformation leadership by providing strategic guidance on cyber security risks, mitigation strategies, and technology investment priorities.
+ Ensure alignment with relevant industry standards and frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, IEC 62443, NIS2, CIS Controls, and Zero Trust principles.
+ Mentor and coach architects and technology leaders on cyber security best practices, architecture standards, and emerging security technologies.
+ Drive the integration of cyber security requirements into enterprise architecture governance, technology portfolio management, and investment decision processes.

Certifications
  
  

* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Extensive experience (Minimum 12+ years) in IT security, with a significant focus on enterprise architecture and strategic security design.
* Proven experience in a senior or lead architect role, developing and implementing security strategies for a large, global organization.

**Skills**

* Technical Security Expertise

+ Security Architecture
+ Identity & Access Management
+ Zero Trust Architecture
+ Cloud Security
+ Application Security
+ Data Security
+ OT/ Industrial Security
+ Cyber Resilience & Disaster Recovery
+ AI Security & Responsible AI
+ Security Monitoring & Threat Detection
+ Cloud knowledge (AWS/ Azure) and their security services
+ Understanding security frameworks and regulatory requirements: ISO 27001, NIST, Cybersecurity Framework IEC 62443, NIS2, CIS Controls, GDPR, Zero Trust principles

* Leadership & Communication

+ Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical topics into business-focused recommendations and executive decision material.
+ Strong consulting, influencing, and facilitation skills, with the ability to drive alignment across business leaders, technology teams, and external partners.
+ Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and mentor architects within a global enterprise environment.
+ Open-minded, collaborative, and passionate about continuous learning and technology innovation.

**Extraordinary Teams Building Inspiring Projects**
Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place.

**Job Summary**
Bechtel India Office is currently seeking Telecom Engineers for Large Infrastructure Projects especially related to Technological Buildings. * Preparation of Engineering drawings like I/O Scheduling, Wiring Drawing, Cable Schedule, Loop Drawings, Instruments Location & Installation Drawing, Cable Route & Tray Route Layout, JB Termination Drawing, Control & network patch panels drawings.

* Design and Engineering of CCTV, Surveillance System, PAGA, Access Control Systems and Intrusion Detection Systems.

* Design and Engineering of Leak Detection System and interface with Building Management System.
* Preparation of Subcontract Requisitions and Bid Evaluation and Vendor Print Review.
* Telecommunication system design including design of campus backbone cabling, trays and conduits tying various buildings. Designing Wireless LAN with wireless access points and wireless control points.
* Develop System Architecture of Telecom Networks including selection of network switch, routers, firewall and VOIP based equipment's and phone.

* A recognized bachelor's degree in engineering in Electrical & Electronics, Electronics & Telecommunications or Instrumentation & Control Systems from an accredited college or university.

* Engineering and Design experience in EPC and/or FEED Projects.
* Experience in Design and Engineering of Large Infrastructure Project like Smart City, Rail Systems, Airports or Technological Buildings.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a skilled
**Infrastructure Engineer**
to join our global team and help design, implement, and maintain our private and public cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have experience in
**NetApp storage**
, server hardware management,
**Grafana**
, Linux system administration and automation tools like
**Terraform**
and
**Ansible**
. You will play a key role in managing and optimising our infrastructure, ensuring reliability, scalability, and security.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Configure, administer, and troubleshoot NetApp storage solutions.
* Manage and maintain Linux-based systems, ensuring optimal performance, security and uptime.
* Automate infrastructure deployment and configuration management using Terraform and Ansible.
* Monitor system performance, conduct regular updates, and perform issue resolution.
* Collaborate with development, operations, and security teams to support business needs.
* Document configurations, procedures, and best practices.
* Work remotely while collaborating closely with onsite engineers to support hardware installations, upgrades, RMA processes, troubleshooting, maintenance, and other critical infrastructure tasks as needed.
* Participate in on-call rotations.

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* Hands-on experience with NetApp ONTAP storage administration and troubleshooting, including on-premises MetroCluster deployments and FSxN and CVO in public cloud environments.
* Experience with server hardware management, including firmware upgrades, component replacements, and RMA processes.
* Strong Grafana proficiency: building and maintaining custom metric exporters and integrating externally provided exporters; designing dashboards; and managing alerting configuration as code, deployed via Terraform.
* 3+ years of experience in an infrastructure or systems engineering role.
* Strong expertise in Linux system administration (e.g., RHEL, Ubuntu, CentOS).
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation tools like Terraform and Ansible.
* Experience managing virtual machines on OpenStack, including provisioning, lifecycle management, and troubleshooting.

**Desirable Skills (Nice to Have):**

Proven scripting skills, ideally with Python.

If you have a passion for infrastructure, automation, and optimising IT environments, we’d love to hear from you!

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

andidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled

in accordance with

our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to

assist

our team in evaluating qualifications.

title: Sr. Migration Modernization Architect, Professional Services
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Are you an experienced Cloud architect/developer who can assist our customers in Application modernization, Design and development of cloud native applications and/or re-engineering applications that can fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like to work on a variety of game changing projects, at the forefront of application development and cloud technology adoption? This role is open for Delhi/NCR.
  
  
As an architect you would champion applications to be cloud optimized by making them well-architected ,enabling them to reap the benefits of elasticity, horizontal scalability, automation and high availability. You should have a knack of GenAI tooling to driving application modernization at scale with GenAI tools.
  
  
On the AWS platform services such as Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancing, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Amazon Elastic Container Services to name just a few, provide opportunities to design and build cloud ready applications.
  
  
AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands on technical architects to help accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. This is an opportunity to join Amazon’s world class technical teams, working with some of the brightest engineers while also developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies.
  
  
Professional Services engage in a wide variety of projects for internal customers and partners, providing collective experience from across the AWS customer base and are obsessed about success for the internal customers. Our team collaborates across the entire AWS organization to bring access to product and service teams, to get the right solution delivered and drive feature innovation based upon customer needs.
  
  
Amazon aims to be the most customer centric company on earth. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers critical applications for hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands on Mig and Mod (MM) Architects with:
  
  

* Strong Consulting, client-facing (CXO) level communication driving cloud solutioning and leading technical workshops
* Ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders into implementable solution adhering to well architected framework.
* Problem-solving and analytical thinking driving envisioning , presales and be a thought leader in the domain driving Application discovery , Risk mitigation strategies, Performance testing and validation, Migration and Post-migration optimization
* Deep expertise in large scale cloud migrations, and AWS infrastructure to drive complex cloud transformation journey from Onprem successfully modernizing them to help realize true value from cloud
* Deep expertise in VMware technologies having worked on vSphere administration, vCenter management, NSX networking, vSAN storage, HCX for migrations, VMware Cloud on AWS
* Ability to drive Migration discovery to Mobilize to lead and drive Migration and Modernization end to end.
* Strong experience on Cloud Infra, network, Security and cloud resiliency (DR)
* Ability to modernize application in .Net, Java, Python and get them out of legacy framework to realize true potential of cloud
* hand-on experience in designing and developing web applications, APIs, microservices, and data integrations for cloud native applications
* Knowledge of cloud-native design patterns, including microservices architecture and event-driven systems.
* Demonstrated experience building scalable and highly available applications on AWS, leveraging services such as Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, etc.
* Preferred experience in optimizing cloud-based architectures for scalability, security, and high performance.
* Experience working in Agile development environments, with a strong focus on iterative delivery and continuous improvement.
* Ability to advise on and implement AWS best practices across application development, deployment, and monitoring

**Additional Desired Skills**

* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
* Scripting (Python, PowerShell)
* CI/CD pipelines
* Programming Skill with Java, .Net
* Container technologies
* Database migrations
* Knowledge of compliance frameworks
* Multi-cloud experience

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
* Knowledge of security and compliance standards including HIPAA and GDPR
* Knowledge of at least one programming language such as Java, C#, JavaScript, Python, Ruby or Perl
* 3+ years of continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) experience
* Experience in Kubernetes, Docker or containers ecosystem, or experience in software development
* Experience in database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with fully automated machine training (automatic re-training, automatic testing)
* Master's degree in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field, or PhD or equivalent research experience and 9+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS ProServe IN - Karnataka

title: Application Support Engineer

**Project Role :** 
 Application Support Engineer
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Act as software detectives, provide a dynamic service identifying and solving issues within multiple components of critical business systems.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 AIX System Administration
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum
 **5** 
 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

**Summary:**
 As an Application Support Engineer, a typical day involves acting as a software detective by investigating and resolving issues that arise within various components of essential business systems. This role requires a proactive approach to monitoring system performance, diagnosing problems, and ensuring the smooth operation of critical applications. The position demands continuous engagement with complex environments to maintain system stability and support business continuity through timely and effective problem resolution.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
 Manage, configure, and maintain IBM AIX environments across production, development, and test systems.
   

  

 Perform installation, patching, and upgrades of AIX operating systems and related software.
   

  

 Administer and optimize LPARs, VIO servers, and PowerHA clusters for high availability and performance.
   

  

 Monitor system performance and implement tuning measures to ensure optimal system efficiency.
   

  

 Manage system backup, restore, and disaster recovery operations (using tools like NIM, TSM, etc.).
   

  

 Plan and execute capacity management and resource allocation activities.
   

  

 Troubleshoot and resolve complex incidents, service requests, and performance issues.
   

  

 Collaborate with application, database, and network teams for cross\-functional issue resolution.
   

  

 Implement and maintain security hardening, patch compliance, and audit requirements.
   

  

 Automate repetitive operational tasks using shell scripting or other automation tools.
   

  

 Support migration and modernization initiatives involving AIX and related technologies.
   

  

 Maintain detailed documentation of configurations, standard operating procedures, and change records.
   

  

 Participate in on\-call rotation and provide 24x7 production support as required.
   

  

 Mentor and guide junior system administrators within the team.
   

  

**Professional \& Technical Skills:**
 Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
   

  

 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in AIX system administration in large enterprise environments.
   

  

 Strong knowledge of AIX 7\.x and above, VIOS, and PowerVM technologies.
   

  

 Experience with PowerHA (HACMP) clustering and disaster recovery setups.
   

  

 Proficiency with NIM (Network Installation Manager) for system deployment and management.
   

  

 Good to have exposure with backup solutions (TSM, NetBackup, or equivalent).
   

  

 Strong shell scripting (Korn, Bash) and automation skills.
   

  

 Familiarity with SAN, storage provisioning, and file system management (JFS2, GPFS).
   

  

 Understanding of ITIL processes (Incident, Change, and Problem Management).
   

  

 Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
   

  

**Additional Information:**
 Experience with AIX on IBM Power10 or Power9 hardware.
   

  

 Knowledge of Linux or other UNIX variants.
   

  

 Exposure to cloud or hybrid infrastructure integrations.
   

  

 IBM Certified System Administrator – AIX certification.
   

  

 Experience in leading technical projects or initiatives.
   

  

**Additional Information:**
* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in AIX System Administration.
* This position is based at our DDC5E \- SEZ office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Solutions Development Architect
description:
**Meet the Team**
 Security at Cisco is no longer a product you bolt on — it is table stakes, and it is a lifecycle, and our Customer Experience (CX) Professional Services team in Asia Pacific \& Japan is where that belief meets our largest Service Provider customers. We help Tier\-1 carriers, national operators, mobile network operators, and telco\-cloud/webscale providers across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN, and India transform their security architecture — infusing protection into the network fabric, embedding zero trust by design, and standing up a modern, AI\-driven Security Operations Center. We are a small, senior, high\-trust group of architects of record who operate at the intersection of deep networking and security, and who are trusted by CISOs and CTOs to set the security direction for some of the region's most complex networks. What is exciting is the scope: you own the security agenda for an entire vertical across four diverse markets, and you get to shape how an agentic, AI\-powered SOC and security\-by\-design come to life at carrier scale.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a senior Security Solutions Development Architect, you will drive the CX Security pre\-sales architecture and delivery strategy for highly complex, large\-scale groundbreaking engagements across APJ Service Provider accounts, acting as the security architect of record. You will influence security, network, and operations decisions at executive and C\-levels (CISO, CTO, SVP and above) and translate security architecture into measurable outcomes — risk reduction, faster mean\-time\-to\-detect/respond, lower threat dwell\-time, stronger compliance posture, and analyst productivity — so customers can see the business value, not just the technology. You will architect zero trust transformations and security\-by\-design controls (segmentation, secure connectivity, policy\-based isolation) that embed protection into routing, transport, data center, edge, and peering layers, then develop the observability framework and high\-fidelity detections that power an agentic, AI\-driven SOC. You will uncover new and expansion security opportunities, lead CX security RFI/RFP responses, and scope and price cross\-architecture proposals so they can be cleanly delivered by CX's technical delivery teams — staying lightly engaged post\-sale to ensure realization and bring together reference wins. Success looks like a growing, balanced CX Security business across APJ SP, with customers advancing along zero trust, security\-by\-design, and SOC\-modernization journeys that Cisco helped them design and deliver.
   

  

**Security \& Service Provider Technical Domains**
 You Are Expected To Bring Architect\-level Expertise Across At Least Two Domains — Networking And Security Architecture — With Cross\-domain Fluency Over The Following
   

  

* Zero Trust Architecture — zero trust design principles, identity and access, least\-privilege/segmented access, and assume\-breach patterns at SP scale.
* Security\-by\-Design \& Infrastructure Controls — segmentation/micro\-segmentation, secure connectivity, DDoS protection, secure firewalling, and SP edge/peering security embedded in the fabric.
* Networking Foundation — SP routing, transport, data center, and edge architectures as the substrate into which security is infused.
* Observability \& Telemetry Engineering — data collection, parsing, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and federated search across distributed, multi\-cloud data estates.
* Modern SOC \& Agentic Operations — high\-fidelity, actionable detection use cases, agentic investigation and response, advanced analytics, and SOC modernization.
* AI\-Driven Security — embedding AI and agentic capabilities across the security lifecycle to accelerate detection, investigation, and response.


**APJ Regional Context**
 This role drives and grows the CX Security business across the APJ Service Provider vertical — operating across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN (Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam), and India — markets with varying security maturity and regulatory environments. You will account for the global nature of strategic SP customers while navigating multi\-country deployments, data sovereignty, in\-country data residency, and security/privacy compliance requirements specific to APJ, and partner with the regional SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to orchestrate large\-scale transformations. Preferred hiring locations: Indonesia, Malaysia, India.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree \+ 12 years of related experience, OR Master's degree \+ 8 years, OR PhD \+ 5 years, OR equivalent relevant work experience.
* Deep networking expertise with demonstrated ability to apply zero trust security design principles (verify explicitly, least\-privilege access, assume breach) to transform customer security architectures at Service Provider scale.
* Shown mastery of security\-by\-design (network segmentation/micro\-segmentation and infrastructure controls) AND the design of observability frameworks and a modern SOC for detection and response (data collection, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, federated search, and high\-fidelity detection use cases).
* Practical AI fluency for security: demonstrated experience designing AI\-driven detection, investigation, and response and building high\-fidelity, agentic/automation\-led SOC workflows.
* Deep technical pre\-sales experience AND professional services/delivery experience, holding required certifications: CCNP Service Provider (or CCNP Enterprise/equivalent) AND CCNP Security (or equivalent) AND CISSP (or equivalent senior security architecture certification).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Expert\-level certifications such as CCIE Service Provider, CCIE Enterprise, or CCIE Security; and/or security architecture frameworks such as SABSA or TOGAF.
* Zero trust / SOC and security\-analytics certifications (e.g., Splunk certifications, SANS/GIAC such as GCIH/GCDA), AI\-security credentials, and/or cloud\-security specializations (AWS / Azure / GCP).
* Strong, fluent English (written and spoken) with the executive presence to influence at CISO/CTO/SVP\-and\-above level across diverse APJ markets.
* Recognized strategic influencer, comfortable shaping customer security vision and representing Cisco in industry forums and strategic alliances.
* Skilled at orchestrating the SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to deliver large\-scale, multi\-country Service Provider security transformations.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
