title: Manager-Cyber Security
description:
Eden is seeking an experienced Cyber Security Manager to manage it’s Head office and plant/manufacturing sites from cyber threats. The role covers both IT (Plant \& corporate network, ERP, email, cloud) and OT (Operational Technology\-SCADA/ICS, PLCs, plant control systems) environments, and is responsible for building a resilient security posture, ensuring regulatory compliance, and leading incident response across all locations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Security Strategy \& Governance
 


* Design, implement, and maintain cybersecurity policies covering corporate IT and plant OT/ICS environments
* Define and own Eden's cybersecurity roadmap, aligned with business growth and plant expansion plans
* Prepare cybersecurity reports and risk dashboards for senior management and leadership review



  





**IT \& OT Security Operations** 



* Manage network segmentation between corporate \& plant IT and plant OT networks (firewalls, DMZs, air\-gapping where required)
* Monitor for threats using SIEM/SOC tools; lead incident response, containment, and forensic investigation for breaches
* Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing across office and plant networks
* Oversee identity \& access management (IAM), privileged access controls, and multi\-factor authentication rollout
* Coordinate with OEMs/vendors on SCADA/PLC patch management and secure configuration of plant control systems



 Compliance \& Risk
 


* Ensure compliance with IEC 62443 (industrial automation security), ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, and CERT\-In guidelines
* Liaise with CERT\-In and sector\-specific regulatory bodies on mandatory incident reporting
* Support business continuity and disaster recovery (BCP/DR) planning for plant and office operations



  





**Security Monitoring \& Incident Response** 



* Monitor security alerts and coordinate investigation of cybersecurity incidents.
* Develop and maintain Incident Response and Business Continuity procedures.
* Coordinate response to malware, phishing, ransomware, unauthorized access and data leakage incidents.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis and prepare incident reports.
* Coordinate with SOC/MSSP and external cybersecurity vendors.
* Conduct periodic incident\-response drills/tabletop exercises.


- 


**People \& Awareness** 



* Conduct employee cybersecurity awareness training and phishing\-simulation programs across office and plant staff
* Build and manage relationships with external security auditors, consultants, and managed security service providers



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* B.E./B. Tech in Computer Science or IT or Electronics \& Communication or related field
* Certifications (one or more preferred): CISSP, CISM, CEH, GICSP (ICS/SCADA security), ISO 27001 Lead Auditor
* 5\-8 years of total cybersecurity experience, including at least 3\-4 years securing industrial/plant (OT) environments
* Prior experience in oil \& gas, power, wind, solar, hybrid energy, or manufacturing industries strongly preferred



  





**Key Skills** 



* Firewalls, IDS/IPS, network segmentation, VPN
* SIEM tools (Splunk, QRadar, ELK) and SOC operations
* ICS/SCADA protocols (Modbus, DNP3, OPC) and associated security risks
* Cloud security (AWS/Azure) for hybrid IT infrastructure
* Regulatory knowledge: IT Act 2000, CERT\-In directions, CEA Cyber Security in Power Sector Regulations\& Guidelines
* Network security, firewalls, VPN, IDS/IPS
* SIEM / SOC operations, EDR/XDR and endpoint security, Vulnerability management
* Penetration testing / VAPT, Data protection and DLP

 At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.
   

  

 AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high\-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go\-to\-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.
   

  

 The Field Application Engineer will be the technical interface for AMD’s commercial products with commercial end customers in the INDIA region. As an Engineer, the role will be responsible for technical support for AMD’s commercial products, particularly commercial client and workstation. In this position, the individual will help AMD drive a new era of commercial computing by engaging with large INDIA end customers to demonstrate how AMD technology can be used to address the needs of their business. The role will provide technical support for AMD’s commercial pipeline with a special focus on pre\-sales and development support activity as opportunities transition from opportunity to deployment. Building confidence with key customer influencers and overcoming technical objections will be critical for success in the role. Post\-sales technical support is also required as the account encounters technical issues. title: Information Technology Head (PSS08064)
description:
**About The Company**
 It began as a distributor of some of the world's most iconic liquor brands in India, partnering with global companies. Building deep expertise in sales, marketing, and distribution, they transitioned from distributors to brand creators—launching their own labels and crafting products known for bold flavours, unique packaging, and strategic pricing. It is a fast\-growing alco\-bev company with 15 in\-house brands, an annual turnover of INR 5 Billion and 2 million\+ cases sold annually.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 Looking for a
 **young, dynamic IT professional** 
 who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment. This is a hands\-on leadership role where you will own the full IT function—from driving our ERP implementation on SAP to keeping our networks secure and our IT assets humming. You will work directly with the Co\-Founder and cross\-functional teams, rolling up your sleeves to get things done while building a robust IT foundation for scale
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* 1\. ERP Management
+ Act as the IT project manager for the SAP ERP rollout—the single point of accountability for IT deliverables on the project.
+ Ensure SAP implementation follows the right practices: configuration governance, change management protocols, data migration standards, and UAT sign\-offs.
+ Liaise with the SAP implementation partner, internal stakeholders, and the business to keep the project on track and on time.
+ Own IT\-side risks and escalations; flag issues early and drive resolution.
+ Post go\-live, manage SAP support, user access, and version/patch governance.

* Networking \& Data Security
+ Manage and maintain the company's network infrastructure—LAN/WAN, switches, firewalls, VPNs, and IP address management.
+ Administer Microsoft 365 / Outlook setup, user provisioning, email security, and access controls across the organisation.
+ Enforce data security policies: endpoint protection, access rights management, data backup, and incident response.
+ Monitor network performance and uptime; proactively identify and resolve vulnerabilities.
+ Ensure compliance with IT security best practices and support any audits or assessments.

* IT Asset Management
+ Manage the full lifecycle of IT assets—laptops, desktops, printers, and peripherals—including procurement, tagging, allocation, and decommissioning.
+ Oversee office Wi\-Fi infrastructure: access point setup, coverage, performance, and troubleshooting.
+ Manage CCTV and physical security systems across offices and facilities.
+ Maintain an accurate, up\-to\-date IT asset register and ensure timely refresh/replacement cycles.
+ Coordinate with vendors for hardware procurement, AMCs, and service contracts.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**
* 7–12 years of experience in IT roles with end\-to\-end ownership of IT operations.
* Demonstrated experience working on an ERP implementation (SAP experience preferred); having managed IT workstreams on a project is a strong plus.
* Solid hands\-on expertise in networking, data security, and Microsoft 365 / Outlook administration.
* Proven track record in IT asset and infrastructure management in a multi\-location setup is a plus.
* Familiarity with AI tools and willingness to explore AI\-led solutions to improve IT efficiency is a plus.
* Strong vendor management skills and commercial awareness.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management—comfortable working directly with senior leadership.


 Why Consider this Opportunity?
   

  

* Lead a critical IT function in a fast\-growing alco\-bev company with significant market presence.
* Drive a strategic SAP ERP implementation impacting core business operations.
* Work directly with the Co\-Founder and cross\-functional teams, influencing organizational scale and efficiency.
* Build and secure IT infrastructure foundational to rapid growth and innovation.
* Engage with emerging technologies including AI to enhance IT capabilities.

 our wins – big and small.

 Principle 
 

 Platform

 Engineer

 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.
 

  
 





 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 

  
 





  
 






 Your 
 

 impact
 


  
 






 As the Principal HA \& DR Engineer, you will own the architectural strategy and technical execution for the platform's resilience, high availability, and disaster recovery lifecycle. You will design, build, and 
 

 deliver
 

  technical solutions that support Platform
 

  availability, resiliency, and 
 

 disaster response
 

 .
 


  
 






 You will act as the principal authority for business continuity across our global infrastructure, defining the guardrails for system fault\-tolerance and leading cross\-functional coordination for multi\-region disaster preparedness
 

  between both cloud and on prem
 

 . You will also design automated failover mechanisms, champion chaos engineering practices, and develop robust mitigation strategies to eliminate single points of failure across both cloud and on\-premises infrastructure.
 


  
 





  
 





  
 





  
 





  
 





  
 




**You will :**

  
 



* Drive the HA Strategy \& Roadmap: Own the end\-to\-end design and technical execution of our global High Availability roadmap, ensuring continuous platform uptime across both cloud and on\-premises environments.


* Build \& Implement HA Architectures: Hand\-on code, configure, and engineer active\-active clustering, global load balancing, and real\-time database replication to completely eliminate single points of failure.


* Establish the Resiliency Practice: Build and champion our foundational Resiliency Engineering framework from scratch, defining platform\-wide standards for fault tolerance and self\-healing.


* Influence Engineering Teams: Partner with and influence cross\-functional engineering squads to ensure self\-healing mechanisms and automated recovery protocols are embedded directly into their core deliverables.


* Bootstrap Chaos Engineering: Introduce and champion our first\-ever Chaos Engineering program; you will define the strategy, establish the safe guardrails, and prepare the organization to execute its initial automated fault\-injection and live\-fire failover drills.


* Build \& Implement HA Architectures: Hand\-on code, configure, and engineer active\-active clustering, global load balancing, and real\-time database replication to completely eliminate single points of failure.


* Optimize Uptime \& Manage Risks: Monitor infrastructure performance KPIs to identify potential bottlenecks, mitigate shortage or overload risks before they cause downtime, and ensure compliance with strict Customer SLA requirements.




  
 






 Your skills and experience
 


  
 






 We work with a broad range of technologies, and we don’t expect you to know everything on day one. You’ll have time to learn our tools and grow into the role. We're looking for diverse experiences to help strengthen our team.
 




  
 






 Essential
 


  
 



* 8\+ Years of HA Engineering: Extensive HA experience across cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and on\-premises environments.


* Technical Influence: Proven ability to evangelize resiliency standards and influence cross\-functional engineering teams to build self\-healing features.


* Failover \& Replication: Hands\-on expertise with real\-time data replication, database clustering, and automated, zero\-downtime traffic failover.


* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Advanced proficiency with Terraform or Ansible to build and replicate highly available environments programmatically.


* Systems \& Container Engineering: Deep technical knowledge of Linux internals and container orchestration using Kubernetes (K8s).


* Hybrid Network Engineering: Hands\-on experience managing complex hybrid networking topologies, including BGP routing, DNS management, Anycast, and CDNs.


*   Strategic Execution: Ability to translate high\-level uptime requirements into a technical roadmap and personally execute the engineering work.





 Desirable
 


  
 



* Experience supporting SaaS products.


* Experience with Incident Management, Post Mortems and related practices.


* Knowledge of observability and monitoring best practices.


* Experience operating within one or more public clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure).


* Experience with configuration management, and infrastructure as code


* Knowledge of observability and monitoring best practices




  
 




**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

title: Integration Engineer - Mediation
description:

 We are looking for a highly skilled Telecom Mediation Specialist with strong expertise in the deployment, integration, configuration, development, and troubleshooting of Telecom Mediation platforms.

 Experience with automation, Kafka/real\-time streaming, cloud technologies, and Gen\-AI tools will be an added advantage.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Deploy, install, configure, upgrade, and troubleshoot mediation platforms across Bare Metal, VM, Cloud, and Container/Kubernetes environments.
* Configure and manage mediation workflows for high\-volume CDR processing.
* Integrate mediation platforms with various Network, IT, Core, Packet Core, Charging, Billing, and downstream systems.
* Design and develop mediation solutions for Charging \& Billing, IMS/VoLTE, 4G, and 5G use cases.
* Perform end\-to\-end data reconciliation across network elements, mediation, and downstream systems.
* Develop and maintain mediation components, utilities, scripts, and automation frameworks.
* Use Java, C, Python, Shell, and/or Perl for development and automation activities.
* Build, deploy, and develop real\-time streaming applications using Apache Kafka or Apache Flink.
* Explore and leverage Gen\-AI tools to improve engineering productivity, troubleshooting, automation, and solution development.
* Strong hands\-on experience with telecom mediation platforms such as Ericsson Mediation OR Nokia/Comptel Mediation OR Amdocs Mediation/Oracle RBM
* Strong understanding of CDR structures, processing flows, mediation rules, parsing, transformation, and enrichment.
* Experience in end\-to\-end mediation solution design/development for Charging \& Billing, IMS/VoLTE, and/or 5G.
* Thorough understanding of ASN.1/JSON/AVRO Schema/Parquet structures.
* Strong proficiency in SQL.
* Hands\-on experience with Java, C, Python, or equivalent programming languages.
* Experience with data parsing, transformation, ETL processes, and API integrations.
* Strong understanding of large\-scale data processing.
* Experience in building, deploying, configuring, or troubleshooting Apache Kafka / Apache Flink environments.
* Understanding of real\-time/event\-driven streaming architectures.
* Experience developing real\-time streaming applications using Kafka is highly desirable.


**The skills you bring:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 5–12 years of relevant experience in Telecom Mediation deployment, development, integration, or solution engineering.

* Recognized certifications in AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, or Kafka will be an advantage.

* Must possess strong experience with Virtualization Technologies

**About the Role** 




  





**KonProzTech Private Limited is the parent company that is building various products in the domain of tax, finance, consulting and compliance areas.** 




**VIDUR is our 1st flagship product that is today live in 170\+ cities with 11,000\+ users growing with 30% MoM.** 




**We recently also launched VMUS, AI native consulting tech platform for boutique consulting for India Inc., MSME and startups.** 




**KonProz has built enterprise grade AI Agents for clients like Nirmal Bang, NexEdge capital in the domain of Insurance and Wealth sector.** 




**We are looking for a Senior Technology Lead who can take end\-to\-end ownership of our technology — products, infrastructure, engineering team, scalability, security and technical decision\-making.** 




**This is not a role where you will only manage developers or attend sprint meetings.** 




**We need someone who can look at the complete technology ecosystem, understand what can go wrong before it goes wrong, step into difficult situations when required and make sure the technology team keeps moving.** 




**You will work closely with the founders and will gradually become the key technology owner across VIDUR’s products and enterprise solutions.** 




  





**What You Will Own Product \& Technology** 



* Take overall technology ownership across VIDUR’s web, mobile, AI and enterprise products.
* Understand the architecture and dependencies across existing products.
* Work closely with product, business and founders to convert business requirements into practical technology execution.
* Review architecture and make decisions around scalability, reliability and performance.
* Evaluate new technologies, AI models, tools and infrastructure where they can improve the product.







**Infrastructure \& Reliability** 



* Own cloud infrastructure, deployment architecture, databases, APIs, monitoring and system reliability.
* Identify infrastructure risks before they turn into production issues.
* Build proper monitoring, alerts, backups, redundancy and recovery processes.
* Handle critical production issues and exception scenarios with the team.
* Improve system performance, scalability and infrastructure costs as the business grows.
* **Engineering Team**
* **Understand the technical capability required for each product and build the right engineering team accordingly.**
* **Allocate developers and technical resources based on product priorities.**
* **Conduct technical interviews and help us hire strong engineers.**
* **Mentor developers and improve engineering standards across the team.**
* **Identify capability gaps, performance issues and dependency risks early.**
* **Build a culture where engineers take ownership instead of waiting for instructions.**
* **Engineering Processes**
* **Establish strong standards around code quality, code reviews, documentation, testing and releases.**
* **Ensure that products are being built with long\-term maintainability in mind.**
* **Create clear development, deployment and incident\-management processes.**
* **Maintain visibility over technical debt and make sure critical issues do not keep getting postponed.**
* **Challenge technical decisions when there is a better or more scalable approach. Risk \& Problem Solving**
* **A major part of this role is seeing problems early. We expect you to:**
* **Identify technology red flags before they become business problems.**
* **Think through failure and exception scenarios while building products.**
* Ask “what happens if this fails?” before something goes live.
* Take ownership during production incidents instead of passing responsibility between teams.
* Understand root causes rather than applying temporary fixes.
* Balance speed of execution with stability and long\-term architecture.
* **Enterprise \& Leadership Exposure**
* **As VIDUR grows, you will also represent the technology function externally. You should be comfortable:**
* **Joining technical discussions with enterprise clients.**
* **Understanding enterprise requirements around integrations, APIs, security, infrastructure and**
* **data.**
* **Explaining our technology architecture in simple business language.**
* **Participating in technology discussions with investors and potential strategic partners.**
* **Responding confidently to technical due\-diligence questions.**
* **Working with founders on technology roadmap, product roadmap and future team requirements.**
* **You do not need to be a salesperson, but you should be able to represent the technology behind VIDUR confidently.**
* **What We Are Looking For**
* **We are looking for someone with 5–9 years of strong technology experience, preferably involving SaaS, AI products, fintech, tax\-tech, consulting\-tech enterprise software or high\-scale B2B platforms.**



  





**You should have:** 



* **Strong understanding of modern web application architecture.**
* **Good understanding of backend systems, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.**
* **Experience working with AWS / Azure / GCP or similar cloud environments.**
* **Understanding of system scalability, security, monitoring and reliability.**
* **Experience managing or mentoring developers.**
* **Ability to review architecture and code even if you are not coding every feature yourself.**
* **Experience handling production systems and real\-world failures.**
* Ability to conduct technical interviews and evaluate engineering talent (How has lifecycle
* changed from SDLC to ADLC).
* Strong communication skills for discussions with founders, investors and enterprise clients.
* Experience working with AI/LLMs, RAG, vector databases, document processing or AI\-native products would be a strong advantage.
* More Important Than the Tech Stack
* We care significantly about how you think. We want someone who:
* Thinks like an owner aka family;
* Takes responsibility when something breaks.
* Challenges assumptions instead of blindly executing requirements.
* Can operate with ambiguity.
* Is comfortable making decisions.
* Flags risks early, even when nobody has asked about them.
* Can go deep into a technical issue when required.
* Understands both technology and its business impact.
* Is willing to take on difficult problems.
* Can build systems and teams, not just features.
* If your first question when something goes wrong is “Who is responsible for this?”, this may not be the right role.
* If your first question is “What happened, how do we fix it, and how do we ensure it does not happen again?”, we would like to speak with you.
* What Success Looks Like
* Within the first year, we would expect you to:
* Have a strong understanding of the complete VIDUR technology architecture.
* Reduce critical production and infrastructure risks.
* Create better visibility over system performance and reliability.
* Build stronger engineering processes.
* Identify and close important skill gaps within the technology team.
* Improve the quality and speed of product releases.
* Create a scalable technical roadmap for future VIDUR products.
* Become the go\-to technology person for founders, enterprise clients and the engineering team.



  





**Why Join VIDUR** 



* **This role gives you the opportunity to take genuine technology ownership without being restricted to one engineering function.**
* **You will work directly with the founders, influence product and architecture decisions, participate in enterprise and investor discussions, build the engineering organization and help shape the next phase of VIDUR.**
* **For someone who demonstrates strong ownership and long\-term commitment, ESOP participation may be explored after completion of 1 year.**
* **This is a role for someone who wants to build — not just manage.**

Participate in troubleshooting network security incidents and perform preliminary root cause analysis. Support the preparation of incident reports and technical documentation. Collaborate with senior engineers during major incident investigations.
* Change and Service Management: Support change implementations related to firewalls, load balancers, and security infrastructure. Use ITSM tools such as ServiceNow (SNOW) for incident, request, and change management activities. Ensure all support activities are documented accurately.
* Network Troubleshooting: Assist in troubleshooting routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, and network security issues. Perform log analysis and packet\-flow reviews under guidance from senior engineers.

**Experience And Skills In The Following Technologies**

* Proficiency with GNU Make as a build orchestration tool
* Semantic versioning, commit conventions, and automated dependency management (Renovate, sv4git, commitlint)
* Container Platform \- maintain Docker base images, agent images, and secure image supply chain via industry best practices such as utilising ACR's and Trivy scanning
* Practical hands\-on Azure skills including Azure AppGW, WAF, Vnet, Routing, Subnets, App services, VM’s, Helm and Helmfile
* Security \& Compliance Azure best practices for cloud security such as enforcing network segmentation, private endpoints, CIS\-hardened images, WAF policies, RBAC, and managed identity patterns
* PowerShell module development, Pester testing, Azure automation
* Bash shell scripting for container entry points and CI tasks
* Active directory, Azure AD, Azure AD B2C
* Git\-based workflows with trunk\-based development and branch\-per\-environment patterns


**Experience In The Following An Advantage**
* Testing \& Quality \- maintain/extend the continuous deployment test framework (Postman API tests, K6 load tests, Pester unit tests)
* Experience managing RabbitMQ clusters in Kubernetes
* Experience with Go / GoLang and Python languages
* Experience with the JinJa2 template engine

**PROFESSION COMPETENCIES**

**CORE COMPETENCIES**
* Communication

**Education \& Qualifications**
 University degree or equivalent preferably in Computer Science Engineering Mathematics or similar. Where applicable a recognised professional qualification is desirable.

Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

description:
**About AlphaSense**
 The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision\-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.
   

  

 The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI\-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S\&P 500\. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!
   

  

**About The Team**
 The role of Engineer II, Information Engineering is responsible for designing, building, and operating scalable enterprise platforms that power internal teams across the organization. This role approaches technology challenges with an engineering mindset \- developing automated, reliable, and secure solutions that reduce manual work and enable teams to operate efficiently at scale.
   

  

 Our mission is to design, build, and operate secure, scalable IT platforms and identity services that power the company. We leverage engineering, automation, and deep systems expertise to reduce operational overhead, increase reliability, and support long\-term organizational growth.
   

  

 This engineer will focus on identity and access management, enterprise systems engineering, enterprise security, and automation\-driven platform development, while supporting complex technical initiatives across the organization. The role requires strong technical expertise, architectural thinking, and the ability to translate business needs into scalable engineering solutions.
   

  

 Working closely with cross\-functional teams, the engineer will help shape the technical direction of enterprise systems while promoting best practices in automation, infrastructure management, and system reliability. This role provides an opportunity to directly impact the productivity, security, and scalability of the company as we continue to grow.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of experience and certifications.
* Strong programming and scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, and Bash.
* Experience integrating systems using RESTful APIs, authentication frameworks such as OAuth, and common data formats such as JSON and YAML.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems (Git) to manage infrastructure, automation, and configuration changes.
* Experience designing and maintaining system integrations and automation using APIs and event\-driven workflows.
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, troubleshooting, and system performance optimization.
* Experience in identity and access management platforms, particularly Okta and Okta Workflows, and experience designing secure identity architectures.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities with a structured and analytical approach to designing technical solutions.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**What You’ll Do**
* Design and build automation\-driven solutions and system integrations that reduce manual operational work and improve reliability across enterprise systems.
* Develop and maintain internal platforms and services that support identity management, enterprise applications, and secure access to company resources.
* Design, implement, and support networking and secure access technologies, including Zero Trust Network Access and identity\-aware access controls.
* Apply engineering best practices such as infrastructure as code, version control, testing, and CI/CD to enterprise systems and automation workflows.
* Define and maintain architecture standards, design principles, and technical guidelines to ensure a consistent and scalable enterprise platform.
* Collaborate with internal teams to understand business needs and translate them into secure, scalable engineering solutions.
* Partner with Security and Compliance teams to support initiatives such as vulnerability management, patching, and incident response.
* Contribute to technical planning and implementation of complex cross\-functional technology initiatives.
* Maintain documentation for system designs, integrations, and automation workflows to support long\-term maintainability.
* Provide technical mentorship and guidance to team members while promoting a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement.
* Stay informed on emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, security, and scalability.


**Nice To Have**
 Experience with the following technologies and concepts is considered a strong plus:
   

  

* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools and automation, including using LLMs or AI APIs to build internal tooling, improve workflows, or enhance operational efficiency
* AWS fundamentals and cloud\-native service architecture
* Experience working with endpoint management platforms, enterprise security tools and APIs, such as Kandji, Microsoft Intune, CrowdStrike, or Cloudflare
* Deeper understanding of enterprise networking concepts
* Familiarity with SQL or lightweight data querying
* Experience with message queues or event\-driven automation architectures.

 At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

 Are you ready to love your job?
   

  

 The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
   

  

**About The Role \& Team**
 As Senior Manager, Incident \& Change Management within Digital Customer Operations (DCO), you will lead a global team of Incident and Change Managers responsible for protecting service continuity, governing operational change, and restoring critical services with speed and control. You will combine advanced, hands\-on ITIL expertise with strong operational leadership across network, infrastructure, data centre and application\-support environments. The role is a senior escalation point for complex regional and global services, engaging executives, customers and technical leaders during high\-impact incidents and major changes. You will drive continuous improvement and digitalization, strengthen customer outcomes, and build a high\-performing team aligned with DCO priorities.
   

  

* As per SITA Career Framework the title will be Senior Manager, Service Operations


**What You’ll Do**
 Incident Management
   

  

* Lead and govern the end\-to\-end Incident Management process, ensuring the rapid restoration of critical services while minimizing business and customer impact.
* Act as the senior escalation point for high\-severity incidents, coordinating technical, operational, and business teams to drive timely resolution.
* Lead crisis management activities during service disruptions, providing clear communication and regular updates to executives, customers, and key stakeholders.
* Drive incident response governance, ensuring adherence to ITIL best practices, escalation procedures, and operational controls.
* Monitor and improve incident management KPIs, including service availability, resolution times, service restoration metrics, and customer impact.
* Lead post\-incident reviews and root cause analysis to identify corrective actions and prevent recurrence.
* Collaborate with Network, Infrastructure, Data Center, Application Support, and Service Operations teams to strengthen service resilience and operational stability.
* Provide leadership during executive\-level escalations, effectively managing communications with senior management and strategic customers.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance incident response effectiveness, operational performance, and customer experience.


**Change Management**
* Lead and govern the end\-to\-end Change Management process, ensuring all infrastructure, network, application, and service changes are implemented in a controlled and risk\-managed manner.
* Establish and maintain Change Management policies, standards, and governance frameworks in alignment with ITIL best practices.
* Chair Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings, evaluating change risks, business impacts, dependencies, and implementation readiness.
* Ensure changes are assessed, approved, tested, and deployed with minimal disruption to business operations and customer services.
* Monitor change effectiveness through KPIs and reporting, including change success rates, failed changes, emergency changes, and change\-related incidents.
* Partner with operational, engineering, and business teams to balance service stability, operational resilience, and business agility.
* Act as the senior escalation point for high\-risk or business\-critical changes, providing clear communication and decision\-making support to senior stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance change governance, reduce operational risk, and improve service reliability across complex enterprise environments.
* Lead post\-implementation reviews and ensure lessons learned are incorporated into future change planning and execution.


**Qualifications**
**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS**
* Continuous Improvement \& Digitalization: Demonstrated ability to use incident, change, SLA and KPI insights to simplify workflows, strengthen controls, automate repeatable activities and improve operational performance.
* Customer\-Centric Thinking: Proven ability to make service decisions based on customer impact, business criticality and transparent communication, while balancing restoration speed, risk and long\-term service quality.
* Self \& Business Leadership: Strong executive presence, judgement and accountability, with the ability to remain composed during crises, set direction, influence decisions and lead teams through ambiguity and operational pressure.
* Advanced hands\-on expertise in ITIL Service Management, with deep experience across Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, and Service Operations governance.
* Extensive experience leading large\-scale operational environments, ensuring service stability, resilience, and continuous operational excellence.
* Strong leadership, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive alignment and decision\-making across cross\-functional and geographically dispersed teams.
* Proven capability in Major Incident and Crisis Management, including leading the response to critical service disruptions and coordinating recovery efforts within complex enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated experience defining, monitoring, and improving Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) to drive operational performance and customer satisfaction.
* Broad technical understanding of enterprise IT environments, including Network Operations, Infrastructure Services, Data Center Operations, and Application Support, enabling effective decision\-making during service\-impacting events.
* Experience acting as the senior escalation point for high\-priority service issues, effectively managing communications and resolutions involving executive leadership, strategic customers, and business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with the ability to assess operational risks, identify improvement opportunities, and drive sustainable service enhancements.
* Proven track record of leading service management teams and fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Experience managing major incidents and enterprise change across large customer accounts, third\-party suppliers and geographically distributed operations.
* This role requires approximately 20% travel to support regional operations, strategic customers, and key service\-management activities.
* At least 10 years of experience in incident management, change management experience, escalation manager and crisis management, or a related discipline.
* Bachelor's degree in, IT, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.


**What We Offer**
 We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

**\# Senior Network Engineer – Cloud Platform Engineering** 




  





**\*\*Location:\*\* Noida – Sector 62**

**\*\*Work Mode:\*\* In\-office, 5 Days a Week** 




**\*\*Shift:\*\* 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM** 




**\*\*WFH:\*\* Eligible after 7:00 PM daily** 




**\*\*Interview Process:\*\* 3 Virtual Rounds** 




  





**\*Budget:\* Up to 30 LPA** 




  





**\#\# About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer to join the Cloud Platform Engineering team and help design, build, automate, secure, and operate cloud, corporate, server, and data center infrastructure.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience across enterprise networking, cloud networking, data center infrastructure, network security, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and production support.
 



  





**\#\# Key Responsibilities** 




  





**\#\#\# 1\. Cloud Network Engineering** 




  





 \* Design and maintain cloud network architectures.
 



 \* Manage VPCs, subnets, route tables, Internet/NAT gateways, Transit Gateway, VPC Peering, private connectivity, load balancers, DNS, and network security controls.
 



 \* Support multi\-account, multi\-region, and multi\-cloud network architectures.
 



 \* Design highly available and resilient network infrastructure.
 



 \* Support cloud landing zones and Cloud Foundation initiatives.
 



  





**\#\#\# 2\. Enterprise \& Corporate Network** 




  





 \* Design, implement, manage, and troubleshoot corporate network infrastructure.
 



 \* Manage LAN/WAN, VLANs, routing, switching, wireless, VPNs, firewalls, proxies, and network access controls.
 



 \* Establish secure connectivity between corporate networks and cloud environments.
 



 \* Support remote\-access and site\-to\-site VPN solutions.
 



 \* Monitor network availability, performance, capacity, and utilization.
 



 \* Troubleshoot complex connectivity issues.
 



 \* Participate in network lifecycle management and technology refresh initiatives.
 



  





**\#\#\# 3\. Server Infrastructure Management** 




  





 \* Support network and infrastructure requirements for physical and virtual server environments.
 



 \* Support Linux and Windows server connectivity.
 



 \* Troubleshoot server connectivity, DNS, routing, firewall, load\-balancing, and certificate\-related issues.
 



 \* Support server provisioning and decommissioning activities.
 



 \* Ensure network segmentation and security controls for server environments.
 



 \* Support connectivity between physical servers, virtual environments, storage platforms, and cloud infrastructure.
 



  





**\#\#\# 4\. Multi\-Cloud Connectivity** 




  





 \* Design and maintain connectivity across corporate networks, data centers, cloud environments, and remote locations.
 



 \* Support connectivity across AWS, GCP, and OCI.
 



 \* Manage AWS Direct Connect, AWS Site\-to\-Site VPN, AWS Transit Gateway, GCP Cloud Interconnect, GCP Cloud VPN, OCI FastConnect, and OCI VPN.
 



 \* Troubleshoot end\-to\-end connectivity across corporate, data center, and cloud environments.
 



 \* Design resilient cross\-cloud network architectures.
 



 \* Support migration of legacy infrastructure into cloud environments.
 



  





**\#\#\# 5\. Network Architecture** 




  





 \* Develop network architecture and design documentation.
 



 \* Establish reference architectures and reusable network patterns.
 



 \* Participate in architecture reviews and technical design discussions.
 



 \* Design network segmentation and IP addressing strategies.
 



 \* Establish standards for routing, connectivity, DNS, network security, and traffic management.
 



 \* Evaluate networking technologies and recommend scalable solutions.
 



  





**\#\#\# 6\. Network Security** 




  





 \* Implement secure\-by\-default cloud and enterprise network architectures.
 



 \* Manage Security Groups, Network ACLs, cloud firewalls, WAFs, firewall policies, network segmentation, and private endpoints.
 



 \* Partner with Security teams on network security standards.
 



 \* Support security reviews and vulnerability remediation.
 



 \* Implement least\-privilege network access.
 



 \* Support TLS/SSL, certificates, encryption, and secure network communication.
 



 \* Support Zero Trust network architecture initiatives.
 



  





**\#\#\# 7\. Infrastructure as Code \& Network Automation** 




  





 \* Develop and maintain network infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
 



 \* Build reusable Terraform modules.
 



 \* Automate network provisioning, configuration, validation, and operational tasks.
 



 \* Develop automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar technologies.
 



 \* Implement automated network configuration and compliance checks.
 



 \* Participate in CI/CD processes for infrastructure changes.
 



 \* Develop automated validation and testing for network infrastructure changes.
 



  





**\#\#\# 8\. Network Monitoring \& Observability** 




  





 \* Implement monitoring and observability for cloud, corporate, and data center networks.
 



 \* Monitor network latency, throughput, packet loss, connectivity, DNS performance, load balancer health, VPN connectivity, and network utilization.
 



 \* Use Datadog, CloudWatch, network telemetry, and flow logs.
 



 \* Develop proactive alerts and operational dashboards.
 



 \* Analyze network telemetry and logs to identify performance and security issues.
 



  





**\#\#\# 9\. Production Support \& Incident Management** 




  





 \* Provide Level 3 support for complex network, server connectivity, data center, and cloud infrastructure issues.
 



 \* Participate in production incident response and on\-call/shift rotations.
 



 \* Troubleshoot network outages, application connectivity, routing, DNS, firewall, VPN, load\-balancing, cloud connectivity, and server connectivity issues.
 



 \* Perform root\-cause analysis and develop permanent remediation.
 



 \* Maintain troubleshooting procedures and runbooks.
 



 \* Participate in disaster recovery and business continuity exercises.
 



  





**\#\# Required Qualifications** 




  





 \* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
 



 \* 8\+ years of enterprise network engineering experience with significant cloud networking experience.
 



 \* Strong hands\-on experience designing and operating cloud and enterprise networking infrastructure.
 



 \* Strong production experience with AWS networking; GCP and OCI networking preferred.
 



 \* Strong experience supporting corporate LAN/WAN environments.
 



 \* Strong understanding of data center networking and infrastructure.
 



 \* Experience supporting physical and virtual server environments.
 



 \* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Routing, BGP, OSPF, VPN, NAT, Firewalls, Proxies, Load Balancing, TLS/SSL, and Network Segmentation.
 



 \* Strong experience with cloud networking services.
 



 \* Strong hands\-on experience with Terraform / Infrastructure as Code.
 



 \* Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar.
 



 \* Experience troubleshooting complex production network and infrastructure issues.
 



 \* Experience with hybrid\-cloud and enterprise connectivity.
 



 \* Experience with network security principles and technologies.
 



 \* Experience working with infrastructure, systems, security, cloud, and application engineering teams.
 



 \* Strong communication, documentation, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.
 



 \* Experience with Cisco, Palo Alto, F5, or equivalent enterprise networking technologies is preferred.

**Required Skills** 



* Strong hands\-on expertise in AWS security architecture (IAM, VPC, KMS, GuardDuty, Security Hub, WAF, Well\-Architected Framework – Security Pillar).

* Strong understanding of application security principles (OWASP Top 10, secure SDLC, API security).
* Familiarity with Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) sufficient to review IaC for security misconfigurations.
* Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks: ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Benchmarks, SOC 2, and PCIDSS.
* Experience producing HLD/LLD security documentation and architecture diagrams.
* Deep understanding of security architecture principles with a Security by Design mindset.
* Knowledge of data encryption techniques for data at rest and in transit.
* Experience with security tooling relevant to AWS and Kubernetes environments, such as cloud\-native security posture tools, container scanning, and SAST/DAST.

* Familiarity with reviewing and evaluating security tools such as EDR platforms, Zscaler, Qualys, and similar solutions as part of architecture and vendor security assessments.

Serve as a cross\-functional technical advisor by applying depth and breadth of knowledge to drive customer success.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a Cisco Network Consulting Security Engineer, you will translate business requirements into technical solutions and design, implement, and manage enterprise security solutions, with a focus on Cisco ISE. You will provide architecture and consulting expertise across customer projects, ensuring alignment with security, compliance, and business objectives. You will lead and guide teams delivering Architecture \& Consulting Services, owning key deliverables such as design documents, migration plans, MoPs, test plans, and campus network best\-practice recommendations. You will facilitate design workshops, provide customer consultancy, and ensure successful delivery against expectations. You will collaborate with customers, SMEs, project managers, account teams, and Product \& Services Sales and Systems/Consulting Engineers to solve complex technology challenges. You will drive process optimization, automation, thought leadership, customer outcomes, and continuous improvement across the practice.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect, design, deploy, and manage enterprise\-level Cisco security solutions, including firewalls, web and email security, VPNs, access control.
* Conduct thorough network security assessments, vulnerability analysis, to identify weaknesses and propose solutions.
* Configure, administer, and optimize Cisco Secure Firewall ASA and Firepower (FTD) firewalls, including Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC), for perimeter defense, data center segmentation, VPN enforcement, and secure segmentation.
* Implement and maintain robust security protocols and measures, including Access Control Lists (ACLs), Network Address Translation (NAT), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS).
* Develop, document, and enforce network security policies, procedures, and standards in compliance with industry best practices and regulatory requirements (e.g., NIST, PCI, DoD STIGs).
* Deploy and manage Network Access Control (NAC) solutions, specifically Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), for 802\.1X authentication, profiling, posture assessments, and policy enforcement across wired, wireless, and data center environments. Including but not limited to Guest Services, Trustsec, pxGrid and 3rd party integrations.
* Troubleshoot complex network, security, and data center incidents, performing root cause analysis and implementing corrective measures to restore services swiftly and prevent future occurrences.
* Design, implement, and enforce security policies with Secure Access, including but not limited to VPN as a Service, Zero Trust Network Access, Secure Web Gateway, Cloud Access Security Broker, Data Loss Prevention, Firewall as a Service with IPS, Cloud Secure Malware Analytics, DNS\-layer security, Secure Internet Access, Secure Private Access and Umbrella.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field \& A minimum of 8\-10 years of experience in network and security engineering with a strong focus on network security, firewalls and Network Access.
* Active professional/expert\-level certifications such as CCNP Security, CCIE Security or CCIE Enterprise or CCIE Data Center are highly preferred.
* Other valuable certifications include ITIL Foundational, CISSP, Palo Alto PCNSE, or CompTIA Security\+.
* Expert\-level knowledge of Cisco routing and switching technologies and protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS, VLANs, STP).
* Strong understanding of security principles, including IDS/IPS, VPN (IPsec, SSL), encryption protocols, and endpoint security.
* Experience with network monitoring, packet capture analysis (e.g., Wireshark, tcpdump), and SIEM tools.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with network automation tools, scripting languages such as Python and Ansible, and AI agents is a plus.
* Knowledge of cloud networking concepts and hybrid cloud architectures, including AWS and Azure.
* Ability to lead and mentor security network engineers, provide technical guidance, and foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with excellent attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive initiatives effectively.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting\-edge of computer technology.

As a Datacenter Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting\-edge of computer technology.

title: Sr Professional Services Consultant (PSC)
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

Working closely with customers, solution consultants, and project managers, you will implement PAB according to best practices and customer\-specific needs. Beyond deployment, you will be a proactive driver, navigating complex environments, anticipating roadblocks, and accelerating our customers' journey to a Zero Trust architecture. You will solidify customer partnerships with Palo Alto Networks by ensuring they successfully adopt and maximize the value of PAB. If you thrive on technical challenges, leading complex deployments, and being the face of strategic, results\-driven implementation, this is your next career move. Your Impact Proactively Drive Technical Deployment: Execute the complete technical lifecycle of PAB implementation, including secure tenant setup and complex Identity Provider (IdP) integrations. Take ownership of the deployment timeline, proactively managing and overcoming any customer hesitations or delays to ensure rapid time\-to\-value Translate Strategy to Security Policy: Convert customer business and security designs into practical, effective PAB configurations, focusing on access controls, data loss prevention (DLP) rules, and web security policies Drive Adoption: Guide customers through the secure and large\-scale deployment of the PAB extension/client to end\-user devices using various enterprise deployment methods (e.g., GPO, MDM) Be a Proactive Technical Advisor: Serve as the go\-to expert for PAB best practices, advanced feature utilization, and performance tuning, actively monitoring environments to pre\-emptively identify, recommend, and resolve potential issues or areas for security posture improvement Resolve Complex Escalations: Act as the primary technical escalation point, performing deep\-dive root cause analysis and coordinating across Support, Engineering, and Product teams for timely resolution Document and Transfer Knowledge: Create high\-quality, customer\-specific "as\-built" documentation and deliver comprehensive operational training and knowledge transfer to customer administrators Advocate for the Customer: Capture and translate valuable field feedback into actionable feature requests, serving as a critical internal voice for product improvement and development Maintain expert\-level understanding of Prisma Access Browser: Stay updated on latest product releases, security trends, and industry best practices. Actively participate in relevant training and certification programs to maintain technical proficiency
   

  

**Qualifications (Additional Job Description)**
 Your Experience 8\+ years of experience required in a hands\-on, technical, customer\-facing role such as Professional Services Consultant, Technical Account Manager, or Senior Sales Engineer Proven track record of proactive engagement; the ability to take initiative to push customers toward successful deployment, manage project risks, and navigate organizational challenges or pushback to maintain project velocity Expert\-level knowledge of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S) and enterprise security principles (Zero Trust, SASE, Firewall, Proxy, VPN) Demonstrated ability to independently lead and execute complex technical projects in customer environments, driving deployment to successful completion Advanced analytical and troubleshooting skills with a methodical approach to identifying, diagnosing, and resolving technical issues (Root Cause Analysis) Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a proven ability to convey complex security topics to diverse technical and non\-technical stakeholders Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) and authentication protocols, specifically integrating solutions with IdPs like Azure AD or Okta using SAML 2\.0 Familiarity with cloud and SaaS security architecture and the challenges associated with securing modern applications and browsers Knowledge of Prisma Access deployment, architecture, and traffic flows These skills are desired and will be prioritized, accelerating time\-to\-value in the role: Basic knowledge of enterprise tools for large\-scale device deployment (e.g., Microsoft Intune, Jamf, SCCM) Industry certifications such as Palo Alto Networks (PCNSA, PCNSE), CISSP, or cloud\-specific security certifications Basic scripting ability (e.g., PowerShell, Python) for automation or data manipulation
   

  

**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com .
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

 EdTech, Education SaaS, Social Impact / Development Sector, or purpose\-led B2B/B2G organisations
   

  

* About iDream Education


**Vision:** 
 Unlimited Learning. Unlimited Growth. For Everyone.
   

  

**Belief:** 
 We believe that access to learning and growth is a fundamental right, and that learning in its truest sense is the joyful unfolding of a being's fullest potential — in all dimensions of life.
   

  

**Mission:** 
 To deliver solutions and experiences that facilitate access to learning and growth for everyone, irrespective of their languages, geographies, abilities, curricula, age groups, learning styles, and socio\-economic status.
   

  

**Education**
 iPrep by iDream Education is a Learning Platform that runs both offline \& online, is bilingual and works on all major hardware devices and operating systems. iPrep delivers curriculum\-aligned digital learning for classes 1st to 12th in English, Hindi, and Regional language mediums for universal reach and learning use as:
   

  

* iPrep Digital Class for Smart Classrooms
* iPrep Digital Library for Tablets/Notebooks based Smart ICT Labs
* iPrep PAL for Personalised Adaptive Learning
* iPrep Tablets for Preloaded Learning Devices with Monitoring

 **Learn Unlimited** 
 .
   

  

 Company website:
 **www.idreameducation.org**
 iPrep website:
 **www.iprep.in**
* Role Summary


 We are looking for an IT Lead — someone who will be the single point of ownership for everything IT at iDream Education. This is not a narrow infrastructure or helpdesk role; it is a domain\-ownership role spanning internal systems, network and cloud infrastructure, our field\-deployed device fleet (iPrep Tablets and other hardware), data security, and compliance.
   

  

 You will be the person who ensures our internal teams never lose a working day to IT friction, and who ensures thousands of devices deployed across schools and NGOs in rural India stay secure, tracked, and functional. You will also be the one building the IT function itself — starting hands\-on, and growing it into a proper team as iDream scales.
   

  

* Key Responsibilities \& Deliverables


**IT Infrastructure, Systems \& Support**
* Own and manage all internal IT infrastructure — networks, servers, cloud services, and systems administration — ensuring uptime, reliability, and security across office operations.
* Run IT helpdesk and support for all employees, ensuring fast turnaround on hardware, software, and access\-related issues.
* Own vendor relationships for hardware, software licenses, ISPs, cloud providers, and AMC contracts — negotiating terms, managing renewals, and controlling IT spend.


**Device \& Field Hardware Fleet Management**
* Own the full lifecycle of iPrep Tablets and other field\-deployed hardware — procurement, provisioning, tracking, maintenance, and end\-of\-life — across schools and NGO locations.
* Build and maintain systems for remote monitoring, troubleshooting, and updates of devices deployed at scale in low\-connectivity environments.
* Coordinate with product and tech teams to ensure hardware compatibility with new iPrep software releases and rollouts.


**Data Security \& Compliance**
* Own information security practices across the organisation — access controls, data backup, endpoint security, and incident response.
* Ensure the organisation's data handling practices align with DPDPA 2023 and other applicable data protection requirements.
* Conduct periodic security audits and risk assessments, and build/maintain IT policies, SOPs, and documentation.


**AI\-First IT Operations:** 
 Bring AI\-augmented workflows into IT operations — from automated monitoring and alerting to AI\-assisted troubleshooting, documentation, and reporting — keeping iDream's IT stack modern and lean.
   

  

* Qualifications \& Experience


**Experience:** 
 5–7 years in IT infrastructure, systems administration, or IT operations, with demonstrable ownership across networks, hardware/device management, and security — ideally including experience managing hardware deployed outside a single office (field, retail, or distributed environments).
   

  

**Sector Context:** 
 Experience in EdTech, the Development sector, or mission\-driven B2B/B2G environments is a strong advantage. Experience managing device fleets in low\-bandwidth or rural contexts is a plus.
   

  

**Technical Proficiency:** 
 Strong grounding in networking, systems administration (Windows/Linux), cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), and device/MDM (mobile device management) tools.
   

  

**Security \& Compliance:** 
 Working knowledge of IT security fundamentals and data protection principles, including familiarity with DPDPA 2023\.
   

  

**Vendor \& Budget Management:** 
 Proven experience managing vendor contracts, AMC negotiations, and IT budgets.
   

  

**AI Fluency:** 
 You use AI tools as a daily productivity layer for monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and reporting — not as a novelty.
   

  

* Key Skills \& Competencies


**What Makes You a Great Fit?**
 You think in systems, not tickets. You've owned IT for an organisation before — not just responded to issues as they came in — and you know how to build infrastructure and processes that scale without breaking. You're equally comfortable troubleshooting a server issue and thinking through how thousands of tablets in rural India stay secure and functional. You're excited about using AI to make IT operations faster and leaner, and you've already started building that into how you work.
   

  

* What We're Looking For — Values \& Culture Fit
* Integrity: Takes ownership of IT infrastructure, security, compliance, and data protection with transparency, accountability, and strong ethical standards.
* Excellence: Builds reliable, secure, scalable, and AI\-enabled IT systems while continuously improving infrastructure, processes, and support.
* Collaboration: Works effectively with internal teams, vendors, and technology partners to ensure seamless IT operations and successful hardware and system deployments.
* Impact: Enables uninterrupted business operations and ensures secure, reliable technology reaches teams, schools, and last\-mile learners at scale.
* Why Join Us


 We are on a mission to take the best of digital learning to every corner of rural Bharat. At iDream, you will have the opportunity to build and own the IT function from the ground up — one that keeps our teams productive and our technology reaching the last\-mile learner securely and reliably.
   

  

* Required Skills (Portal Tags)


 Network Administration, Systems Administration, Cloud Infrastructure, IT Security, Device/MDM Management, Vendor Management, Data Protection Compliance, Decision Making, Analytical Skills
